subsequentActions: GPT53C Stoic attacks Sonnet Vet with 3 creatures
Attacker: Reaper from the Abyss (6/6) unblocked
Attacker: Morkrut Banshee (4/4) unblocked
Attacker: Baneslayer Angel (5/5) unblocked
Sonnet Vet loses 5 life at combat from Baneslayer Angel
GPT53C Stoic gains 5 life
Sonnet Vet has lost the game.

annotations.description: Mulliganed a one-land 6-card hand down to 5 cards. While the hand was risky with only one Mountain and needing blue sources, it had a reasonable curve (2-drop, 3-drop mana rock that fixes colors) and going to 5 cards in Limited is extremely punishing. The Mana Geode in particular would help fix the mana if they could reach 3 mana total.
annotations.betterLine: Keep the 6-card hand. One land with a mana rock is risky but playable, especially since going to 5 severely reduces the chances of having a functional hand. Drawing any land in the first two turns (likely ~60%+) makes this hand serviceable.

annotations.description: Passed with 1 untapped Swamp and no other possible plays. The only available action was activating Scroll of Avacyn ({1}, sacrifice: draw a card), which would have converted an otherwise wasted mana into a card. There's no reason to save the Scroll - they don't control an Angel and are unlikely to get one, and the 1 mana has no other use this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, wasting 1 mana and missing a free card draw.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Scroll of Avacyn to draw a card, since there's no other use for the mana this turn and the Scroll's value doesn't meaningfully increase by waiting.

annotations.description: Player passed in postcombat main with 1 untapped Swamp and Scroll of Avacyn available to activate. There is nothing else to spend the mana on this turn, so activating Scroll to draw a card is free value. Waiting gains nothing — the Scroll has no battlefield synergies and the mana would go to waste.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, ending the turn with 1 unused mana and Scroll of Avacyn still on the battlefield.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Scroll of Avacyn (pay {1} with the untapped Swamp, sacrifice it, draw a card) to gain a free card draw with mana that would otherwise be wasted.

annotations.description: Sacrificed Scroll of Avacyn without an Angel in play, missing the 5 life bonus. Baneslayer Angel is in hand and could potentially be cast in a few turns, at which point Scroll would provide draw + 5 life instead of just draw.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Scroll of Avacyn immediately for just a card draw without the Angel bonus.
annotations.betterLine: Hold Scroll of Avacyn until Baneslayer Angel is on the battlefield to gain the additional 5 life. The extra card draw now is less valuable than 5 life later, especially since the player is at 20 life and not under immediate pressure.

annotations.description: Mistwalker 1/4 could block the attacking Wakedancer 2/2 with no risk — Mistwalker survives at 1/2 remaining toughness, prevents 2 damage to the player, and deals 1 damage to the Wakedancer. There's essentially no downside to blocking.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block, taking 2 damage for free.
annotations.betterLine: Block the Wakedancer 2/2 with Mistwalker 1/4. Mistwalker survives the combat (4 toughness vs 2 power), prevents 2 player damage, and deals 1 damage to the Wakedancer.

annotations.description: Failed to block Mistwalker (1/4 flying) with Reaper from the Abyss (6/6 flying). Blocking would have killed Mistwalker for free (Reaper survives at 6/5) and triggered Morbid at end step to potentially destroy another opponent creature. Instead, took 1 unnecessary damage and missed both the creature trade and Morbid trigger.
annotations.actionTaken: No response (timed out), did not assign Reaper from the Abyss as blocker
annotations.betterLine: Block Mistwalker with Reaper from the Abyss to kill it for free and enable Morbid trigger at end step

annotations.description: Missed a line to kill Reaper from the Abyss (6/6). By casting Magma Jet on Reaper during combat (2 damage) and activating Mistwalker once to make it 2/3 (dealing 2 combat damage), Reaper would have 4 damage marked. Then post-combat, Spitting Earth with 3 Mountains deals 3 more damage (total 7), killing the 6-toughness Reaper. Instead, Mistwalker dies for nothing and Reaper survives.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority during combat, letting Mistwalker deal only 1 damage to Reaper before dying.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Magma Jet targeting Reaper from the Abyss (2 damage), activate Mistwalker ({1}{U}: +1/-1 making it 2/3) to deal 2 combat damage to Reaper (4 total), then post-combat cast Spitting Earth on Reaper for 3 damage (7 total), destroying it.

annotations.description: Passed the turn with 4 untapped mana and useful spells available. Magma Jet could kill Wakedancer (removing a 2/2 attacker) and Scry 2 to dig for answers to Reaper from the Abyss. Since Sonnet Vet controls no creatures, Reaper's morbid trigger from the Wakedancer death would have no valid target on their side. Passing wastes the opportunity to remove an attacker and dig for critical answers.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority in postcombat main phase, ending the turn without casting any spells.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Magma Jet targeting Wakedancer to kill it and Scry 2 to dig for answers to Reaper from the Abyss (such as Angelic Edict or Pirated Copy setup). Reaper's morbid would have no legal target on Sonnet Vet's side.

annotations.description: With Reaper from the Abyss threatening to dominate the game and no creatures or removal in hand that can deal with it, the Scry 2 from Magma Jet could help find critical answers. Sonnet Vet has no board presence and needs to dig for solutions urgently. While saving Magma Jet for later has some merit (e.g., combining with Spitting Earth for 5 damage, or killing an activated Guardian Idol), the Scry 2 to find answers to the 6/6 flier is very valuable when behind.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting Magma Jet
annotations.betterLine: Cast Magma Jet targeting opponent's face (or even the Reaper to set up future removal) to Scry 2 and dig for answers to the Reaper from the Abyss. The 2 face damage is minor but the Scry 2 is crucial when desperately needing to find removal.

annotations.description: Passed priority in precombat main phase with 4 untapped mana and several castable spells. At minimum, Magma Jet (2 mana) provides scry 2 to dig for answers to the Reaper from the Abyss that threatens lethal in coming turns. Being at 12 life facing a 6/6 flyer means finding answers quickly is critical. The scry 2 alone is significant value that was wasted.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting any spells, wasting all 4 mana.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Magma Jet targeting Morkrut Banshee (or even the opponent) primarily for the scry 2 to dig for answers like Angelic Edict or Baneslayer Angel. Could also consider casting Bloodline Pretender as a blocker for ground threats, though it doesn't address the flying Reaper.

annotations.description: Passed priority in postcombat main phase with multiple castable spells and facing lethal clock from Reaper from the Abyss (6/6 flyer). At 12 life, Sonnet Vet dies in 2 attacks. Magma Jet could be saved for instant speed, but Bloodline Pretender as a 2/2 blocker could at least help against Morkrut Banshee, and the scry from Magma Jet is crucial for finding answers to Reaper.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, ending the turn with 4 untapped mana and no board presence.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Magma Jet targeting opponent (or Morkrut Banshee to weaken it) and scry 2 to dig for answers like Angelic Edict to deal with Reaper from the Abyss. Alternatively, deploy Bloodline Pretender as a blocker against ground threats, preserving life total.

annotations.description: At 2 life facing lethal flying threats next turn (Baneslayer Angel 5/5 and Reaper from the Abyss 6/6), Sonnet Vet passed without casting Magma Jet. While the position is likely lost regardless, Magma Jet's Scry 2 could dig for an answer (like Angelic Edict or another removal spell) to survive one more turn. The 2 damage could also be pointed at Morkrut Banshee or the opponent. There's no reason to hold Magma Jet when facing guaranteed lethal next turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting any spells
annotations.betterLine: Cast Magma Jet targeting Morkrut Banshee (or opponent's face) to Scry 2 and dig for an answer to the lethal flying threats next turn

annotations.description: Failed to play Plains before combat when at 7 untapped lands. Playing the land is free and would give access to 3 white mana sources, better enabling Feat of Resistance ({1}{W}) to protect an attacker if the opponent tries removal during combat. With the opponent at 2 life and 11 power of flyers ready to attack, protecting against removal is the main concern.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority in precombat main phase without playing the Plains land drop.
annotations.betterLine: Play Plains first, then move to combat. This maximizes mana available for Feat of Resistance to protect Baneslayer Angel or Reaper from the Abyss if the opponent attempts removal during combat.

annotations.description: At 2 life facing lethal flyers (Baneslayer Angel and Reaper from the Abyss), the player timed out and passed without casting Magma Jet. While the position is almost certainly lost, Magma Jet's Scry 2 could have dug for a potential answer, and the 2 damage could target Morkrut Banshee to reduce its toughness for a future Spitting Earth.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out and passed without casting any spell
annotations.betterLine: Cast Magma Jet targeting Morkrut Banshee (or any target) to get Scry 2 and dig for answers. Even in a near-hopeless position, using available resources gives the best chance of finding a way out.

annotations.description: At 2 life facing lethal flyers (Baneslayer Angel 5/5 and Reaper from the Abyss 6/6), the player passed on casting Magma Jet which provides Scry 2 - a critical dig effect when desperately needing an answer. While 2 damage doesn't kill any of the opponent's creatures, the Scry 2 could help find a miracle answer. The player could target Morkrut Banshee (making it 4/2, killable by Spitting Earth with 3 Mountains) and scry to set up draws.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Magma Jet targeting Morkrut Banshee (or opponent's face) to get the Scry 2 and potentially set up better draws for survival. Even if the game looks nearly lost, the Scry 2 is free value that costs nothing extra since the mana would go unused.
